ability.name: Raging Storm
ability.effect: **Heal (1)** each friendly target. Then, roll a D3 for each enemy target, if any. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the enemy target equal to the roll.
ability.declare: Pick each friendly **^^Thunderscorn^^** unit on the battlefield to be the friendly targets, then pick each enemy unit in combat with any friendly **^^Thunderscorn^^** units to be the enemy targets.
